comment: Two disagreements with the README. It says WA or WR at 0ms gives a low gate during the wait and 200ms a high gate; the code does the opposite, writing 10V at 0 (BtogglerPlus.cpp:412-413 and :488-489) and 0V at 200 (:414-415 and :490-491). It also says the WRN output follows OUT when FADE is at 1ms and GATE otherwise; the code at :452 always copies the IN jack's raw voltage while the route is open, whatever the FADE knob is set to. The WRN outputs are left without a family because what they carry changes with the state: a pulse train while armed, a copy of the input while open.
